scenes.name: ONE SIGN, MANY READERS
lines: Ten people pass a road sign, and each one writes down what it says.
十个路人经过同一块路标，每人都在本子上记下它写着什么。
Later, one of them rubs their note back out. Can the sign go back to before?
后来有一位把自己记下的那一笔倒着抹掉。路标能因此回到没人读过的时候吗？
We like to think a fact just sits out there on its own. Let us count instead.
我们总以为事实独自摆在那里，不靠谁记着。这回不如动手算一算。

scenes.name: WRITING TWO COPIES
lines: Take a qubit in an even superposition. The number linking its two branches is one half.
取一个均匀叠加的量子比特。连接两条分支的那个数，相干，等于二分之一。
Each record of the branch multiplies that number by the record's overlap.
每写下一份记录，这个数就乘上这份记录的重叠。
A phase record has overlap minus i, a quarter turn. Two copies make it minus one half.
相位记录的重叠是 −i，相当于转了四分之一圈；写两份，它就变成 −½。

scenes.name: UNDO ONE, UNDO BOTH
lines: To undo a copy, conjugate it. Its quarter turn runs backwards.
要撤销一份副本，就取它的共轭：那四分之一圈倒着转回去。
Undo copy zero alone: minus one half times i is minus i over two. Not one half.
只撤销第 0 份：−½ 乘以 i 是 −i/2，回不到 ½。
Undo both, and it is one half again. Lean checks all four numbers.
两份都撤销，又回到 ½。这四个数都由 Lean 内核核验。

scenes.name: ONE SURVIVOR
lines: Now take any number of copies, and undo every one except copy k.
现在副本多少份都行，把除第 k 份以外的全部撤销。
If the others have overlaps of size one, what is left is the survivor's overlap times the old number.
只要其余副本的重叠模长都是 1，剩下的就是幸存那一份的重叠乘以原来的数。
Lean checks it: if that overlap is not one, and the number was not zero, undoing the others never brings it back.
Lean 内核检验：只要这份重叠不等于 1、原来的数又不为零，撤销其余副本就回不到原值。
It is like a photo that is gone only when every phone has deleted it.
就像一张照片，只有每部手机都删了，它才真没了。
A fact is hard to unmake because too many hands hold it.
事实难以抹去，是因为握着它的手太多。

scenes.name: TWO SLANTED RAILS
lines: Copies on one axis can be undone in any order. Now a different kind of order: pull a point toward a rail.
同一轴上的副本，撤销先后无关。下面换一种先后：把点往轨道上拉。
Pull halfway to the flat rail, then two thirds of the way to a tilted one.
先往水平轨道拉一半，再往一根斜轨道拉三分之二。
Do it the other way round, and you land eight twenty-fifths across instead of four.
反过来做，落点的横坐标就是 8/25，而不是 4/25。
Lean checks the exact gap. It vanishes for parallel or perpendicular rails, and not for slanted ones.
Lean 内核核验了这道差的精确公式：两轨平行或垂直时为零，斜交时不为零。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Conjugating undoes only copies of overlap size one. Noisy copies need the joint inverse gate.
共轭只能撤销重叠模长为 1 的副本；带噪的副本要靠联合的逆门。
Reading facts as redundant records is this book's interpretation, not a theorem.
把事实读作冗余的记录，是本书的诠释，不是定理。
And why you see one outcome, not a blend, is still an open problem.
至于为什么你看到的是一个结果而不是混合，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-four.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十四章
